case_selection: First registered test and first registered OOD for each family, active pretest-frozen single-seed emission, no replacement for held reference.
reference_hold_rule: Do not render a registered native quality hold or native-reference physics/adapter hold; retain NOT_RENDERED record without replacement. Neural error/physics HOLD does not suppress a qualified-reference comparison.
frame_selection: Last actual complete original native output frame; never select by response magnitude or error.
panels: NN minus native displacement vector Euclidean norm
NN minus native full Cauchy stress tensor Frobenius norm
position_rule: Original native float64 coordinates; verified float32-cast identity against official full-field export. No deformation, smoothing, interpolation, cell averaging, subsampling or point merging.
support_rule: All valid displacement nodes including prescribed and auxiliary nodes; every actual valid volume stress IP. Whole-history primary metrics exclude prescribed entries as defined by the separate audit.
rendering: Orthographic 3-D scatter of genuine point values, not a continuous field contour. Coincident and occluded points remain in the submitted arrays and inventory.
range_policy: Zero to full global maximum over both fixed cases in each family. Native and NN share the same range per quantity. Vector/tensor difference uses a separately shared full-range scale. No percentile clipping. An exactly all-zero field is labelled explicitly and displayed on a 0..1 unit span; actual min/max stay zero.
renderer: Matplotlib Agg, pinned installed numpy 2.3.5 and matplotlib 3.10.8; imported only after final audits and explicit execute flag
primary_metric_rule: The displayed final-frame norms do not replace independently audited whole-history physical-group errors.
derived_scalar_precision: float64; raw NN components are cast exactly from saved emission before vector/tensor invariant evaluation
